scope: Three implementation-role proof-tool source bindings only. This is a bounded source comparison, not proof-gate acceptance, actual control execution, native capture/provider renewal or a general rendering equivalence claim.

relation.checker: The standard typing.cast returns its second argument unchanged. A nonescaping recursive helper consumes plain retained JSON synchronously in its defining anchor iteration; freezing that same anchor in its default parameter preserves its result. Future annotations avoid evaluating the new annotation. Complete remaining executable AST and type comments are identical.
relation.controls: Both added guards reject unavailable source loaders. Under the separately verified standard SourceFileLoader premise those guards do not run; the complete remaining control AST, literals, assertions and type comments are identical. This comparison does not execute the controls.
relation.merger: Only render changes: a record field now uses rstrip before formatting. This is an observable render output change for trailing whitespace and is not declared equivalent. The complete merge_classifications AST and classification CLI early-return branch are identical and do not call render, matching this evidence binding solely to classification validation.

limits: Assumes ordinary unmodified Python standard-library and builtin semantics with plain JSON values. No claim about source/bytecode introspection, import metadata, profiling, unavailable loaders, allocation failures, arbitrary rendering or executable identity. Comments and trivia are bounded by exact whole-source identities rather than claimed identical. Existing command/provider/reconfirmation receipts retain their original scope.
availability: Actual original bytes are required from authenticated local commit/tree/blob objects or explicit configured-origin immutable commit/path reads. Originals remain only in memory, never printed or retained; receipt digests cannot substitute for unavailable originals.
claim_pin_scope: Complete question/provider/replay/owner/test/anchor record plus only its selected implementation evidence with source SHA normalized to the authenticated original. Other evidence bindings remain independently reviewable. Source evidence must not be a provider evidence reference.
